top_choice_rationale: P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) rests on a mechanism that has been measured quantitatively (ternary-complex formation, cooperativity, ubiquitin transfer, cereblon-dependent substrate recruitment) and reproduced independently in many laboratories. It gave other scientists a general capability, and approved cereblon-dependent glue drugs show the principle works in patients, so the lack of an approved PROTAC limits the downstream record but does not make it premature. The citation can be worded as induced proximity as a chemical design principle, without naming a drug. The omissions (Ciulli, Sakamoto, Kim, Gray, Ito) are a consequence of the three-person limit and must be justified in the report. P002 is mature and cleanly attributed but extends the palladium paradigm honoured in 2010, so it ranks second, ahead of no award.
